description: A chicken farmer has sold his chicken and they need to be transported either by bus or by car. A bus can take 100 chicken and takes 2 hours per trip. A car can take 40 chicken and takes 1.5 hours per trip. There can be at most 10 bus trips and at least 60% of the trips must be by car. If the farmer needs to transport 1200 chicken, how many trips of each should be done to minimize the total time needed to transport the chicken?

BusCapacity.definition: Number of chickens that a bus can carry per trip

BusTripTime.definition: Time taken by a bus per trip in hours

CarCapacity.definition: Number of chickens that a car can carry per trip

CarTripTime.definition: Time taken by a car per trip in hours

MaxBusTrips.definition: Maximum allowed number of bus trips

MinCarTripPercentage.definition: Minimum required percentage of total trips that must be by car

TotalChickens.definition: Total number of chickens that need to be transported

objective.description: "Minimize the total time required to transport all 1200 chickens using bus and car trips"

constraints.description: 100 * (number of bus trips) + 40 * (number of car trips) must be greater than or equal to 1200
Number of bus trips must be less than or equal to 10
Number of car trips must be greater than or equal to 1.5 * (number of bus trips)
Number of bus trips must be greater than or equal to 0
Number of bus trips and number of car trips must be integers
constraints.code:
# No additional constraints are needed here because integrality
# is enforced when defining the variables with vtype=GRB.INTEGER.

busTrips.definition: Number of bus trips used to transport the chickens

carTrips.definition: Number of car trips used to transport the chickens
